title: SLICE: Sequential Likelihood-Free Inference via Conformal E-Values
abstract: arXiv:2610.13855v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many scientific models can be simulated but have intractable likelihoods, making frequentist uncertainty quantification difficult. We construct exact anytime-valid confidence sequences for the parameters of such models. At each observation, fresh simulations from each candidate null conformalize a positive predictable score into a conditional e-value; their product is a test martingale, which we invert over the parameter. Validity holds for any such score, whatever its accuracy. We show that the oracle likelihood-ratio score maximizes expected log growth, which motivates approximating it with an amortized neural ratio estimator. On synthetic benchmarks, an audit of model routing in an LLM API, and microlensing data, the resulting confidence sequences stay valid under continuous monitoring, where fixed-sample methods do not, and neural scores remain competitive with exact likelihood ratios and application-specific scores.

translated_title: SLICE：基于共形e值的序贯无似然推断
translated_abstract: 许多科学模型可以进行模拟但其似然函数难以处理，这使得频率学派的量化充满困难。我们为此类模型的参数构建了精确的、随时有效的置信序列。在每次观测时，利用来自每个候选原假设的全新模拟，将一个正的可预测得分共形化为条件e值；这些e值的乘积构成一个检验鞅，我们再对参数在该鞅上进行求逆。无论得分本身的准确性如何，有效性对任何此类得分都成立。我们证明了理想似然比得分能够最大化期望对数增长，这启发我们使用摊销式神经比率估计器来近似它。在合成基准测试、LLM API中模型路由的审计以及微透镜数据上，所得到的置信序列在持续监测下始终保持有效，而固定样本方法则无法做到这一点；同时，神经得分与精确似然比以及针对特定应用的得分相比仍具有竞争力。
tldr: 提出SLICE方法，利用共形e值构建针对难解似然模拟模型的精确随时有效置信序列，在持续监测下保持有效，并通过摊销神经比率估计器近似理想似然比得分。
en_tdlr: SLICE constructs exact anytime-valid confidence sequences for simulation-only models with intractable likelihoods via conformal e-values, remaining valid under continuous monitoring, with amortized neural ratio estimators approximating the oracle likelihood-ratio score.
